s: Today's show is a review day.
We say the words from our last four days of lessons again.
Let's start with the night sky.
Last week we learned moon, star, and sky.
Look, the moon is big and bright tonight.
Do you see the moon, Maya?
The moon is high in the sky.
And there is one star near the moon.
One star, two stars, three stars!
In the morning the sky is blue.
The moon goes away, and the sky is bright again.
We learned match, player, sport, exercise, and trophy.
Last Saturday I watched a football match with my brother.
Did one player play very well?
The player ran and ran, and scored a goal!
Exercise is good for the body.
My friend and I do exercise together in the park.
After the match, the winner gets a trophy.
The trophy is a big gold cup.
I want to win a trophy one day!

We learned shirt, pants, dress, shoes, and hat.
I wear this shirt every week.
Do you like my shirt, Lena?
I wear the dress at parties.
I walk a lot, so my shoes must be good.
I wear the hat in the sun.
Do you wear a hat, Maya?
Yes, my hat is small and black.
I wear my hat when I walk in the park.
We learned one, two, three, five, and six.
I see three stars in the sky.
We learned five words about sport.
And my brother is six years old!
One hat, two pants, three dresses, five players, six trophies!

A leaf is the green part of a tree.
A stone is a small hard rock.
I see a green leaf on the tree.
I found the stone on the road.
The moon and the star are in the sky.
The player wins the match and lifts the trophy.
The shirt, the dress, the shoes, and the hat are my clothes.
Thanks for listening to Muse English.
